name: Frontlines: Pacific
desc:
Frontlines: Pacific is a WWII first-person shooter set in the Pacific Theater. Fight across historic battlefields, recreated at 1:1 scale, with realistic firearms, uniforms, flamethrowers, and tanks.
⚔️ 50+ weapons
👨🏻‍✈️ 60+ uniform items
🌏 5 massive maps from Peleliu to Manila in the Philippines
⏳ 2 game modes + immersive rainstorms and nighttime battles

The original Frontlines, in development since 2017—finally released in beta in 2025!

💰 Join our group!
Earn 20% more credits and unlock the M1 Carbine:
www.roblox.com/groups/6335035

💡 Found a bug? Press F9 to open the developer console, screenshot the issue, and report it to the dev team!
